name: Apoorv Wankhade
profileSummary: Apoorv Wankhade is an Indian cricketer who played for Vidarbha. He made his first-class debut for Vidarbha in the 2012–13 Ranji Trophy on 2 November 2012. In January 2018, he was bought by the Kolkata Knight Riders in the 2018 IPL auction. He had previously been bought by Mumbai Indians in the Indian Premier League.
